items.title: The World's Biggest Mod Site Makes AI Disclosure Mandatory, But Stops Short Of Banning Its Use
items.excerpt: Nexus Mods' new owner rolled out mandatory generative-AI disclosure for mod uploads and a user-side filter to hide AI-assisted mods, declaring 'we are pro-human creativity' while declining an outright ban.

items.title: 'We Are Pro-Human Creativity' — Nexus Mods Forces Mandatory AI Disclosures and Filters, Explains Why It Won't Ban AI Mods
items.excerpt: Nexus Mods now requires disclosure for mods with AI-assisted code or assets and lets users filter AI-assisted mods out of browsing, arguing an outright ban would only push AI use underground.

items.title: As Steam and Itch.io buckle under the weight of 'AI slop', Nexus Mods introduces new AI disclosure rules but won't ban AI mods outright
items.excerpt: The biggest mod site in the world, Nexus Mods, has new mandatory rules about gen-AI usage in mod creation, adding labels and filters rather than a ban.

items.title: Valve cracks down on Steam game submission process as questionable AI clones and vibe-coded slop flood its store
items.excerpt: Valve published a Steam developer post tightening its pre-release review: a new submission checklist and warnings of longer approvals as a surge of AI-cloned and vibe-coded games floods the queue.

items.title: Valve warns of slower Steam approvals, possibly because of AI
items.excerpt: In a blog post Valve confirmed slower Steam approvals after Next Fest submissions doubled historical highs, and outlined tips to clear pre-review faster, as AI-made games flood the platform.

items.title: Valve admits it's 'running behind' on approving Steam games because it has to keep re-reviewing them, which surely has nothing to do with AI
items.excerpt: As wishlisted games miss their release dates, Valve creates a new checklist to help devs get it right the first time, amid a backlog developers blame on AI-generated submissions.

items.title: Epic Games online director says Valve's response to "Steam's AI clone and slop problem" isn't enough
items.excerpt: After Steam announced changes to its game review process amid an AI flood, Epic's online services director argued Valve's response falls short — despite Epic's own AI-first push.

items.title: 94% of Game Studios Use AI But Rate Their Integration 3/10, And That Gap Is Why "Made With AI" Labels Are Already Meaningless
items.excerpt: A studio survey finds 94% of game studios already use AI in some capacity but rate their own integration around 3/10 — data Wccftech says backs Tim Sweeney's argument that Steam's AI labels are meaningless.

items.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Powers Neural Rendering and AI Characters in Games
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's developer roundup for RTX Spark: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B for on-device AI characters via the In-Game Inferencing SDK, eight RTX Kit neural rendering SDKs (Neural Texture Compression, Character Rendering), an RTX Branch of UE 5.8, and MotionBricks SOMA human-motion models.

items.title: [지스타 26] AI부터 릴레이톡까지, 유니티 인디 환경 키운다
items.excerpt: 유니티가 지스타 2026에서 인디 개발자 지원 프로그램을 운영한다. 행사에 앞서 인공지능을 활용해 게임을 만드는 '유니티 AI 게임잼'을 열고, 전 세계 30개 인디 게임을 소개하는 유니티 월드 쇼케이스를 선보인다.

items.title: AI에 게임 도둑 맞았습니다
items.excerpt: 코딩 AI가 보편화되며 인디 게임의 소스 코드와 디자인을 무단 복제하는 클론 피해가 급증했다. 출시를 앞둔 1인 개발작 '슬롯바운드'도 중국 대형 플랫폼 미니게임으로 도용됐고, 원작자는 해외 플랫폼 신고 절차의 벽에 부딪혔다.

items.title: Shogun 2 – Complete Edition was "not a Creative Assembly developed game," says Total War VP after it was pulled amid generative AI concerns
items.excerpt: Total War VP Roger Collum said the AI-upscaled Shogun 2 Complete Edition was externally developed — 'we took our eyes off its external development' — after the remaster was pulled over generative AI asset concerns.

items.title: Creative Assembly Finally Addresses The Shogun 2 Remaster Disaster By Pointing Fingers
items.excerpt: Creative Assembly VP Roger Collum addressed the AI-upscaled Shogun 2 remaster pulled from sale, claiming the buck stops with CA while repeatedly placing blame on external developer Mataboo.

items.title: New Hogwarts Legacy Trailer Shows Off Nvidia's DLSS 5 Enhanced Lighting and Materials
items.excerpt: Nvidia showed DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy, where the AI-enhanced lighting and materials model is tuned far more subtly than earlier demos, steering clear of altering character faces. (Deprioritized DLSS 5 per-game pattern.)
